About us

Made To Stick.

Hajur Stickers was built on a simple promise: fun, aesthetic, high-quality stickers for everyone — vinyl decals for your laptop, holographic packs for your bottle, and fully custom stickers made just the way you imagined them.

Every sheet is designed or cut with care, checked for quality, and packed carefully so it arrives ready to peel and stick.
